viscript_shop.data.merchant.flagGroups.t: Controls merchandise access through the condition group relation. No condition groups or only empty groups means unrestricted access.

viscript_shop.editor.section.shop.promot: Check to expand and edit shop-wide promotions. Unchecking disables shop-wide rules while retaining their configured values.
viscript_shop.editor.section.category.pr: Check to add category rules or override inherited settings. When unchecked, this level has no local configuration and still inherits enabled shop-wide promotions.
viscript_shop.editor.section.merchant.pr: Check to add merchandise rules or override inherited settings. When unchecked, this level has no local configuration and still inherits enabled parent promotions.
viscript_shop.editor.section.stage.tip: Check to expand and edit stage restrictions. Unchecking allows unrestricted access while retaining the configured conditions.
viscript_shop.data.shop.promotion_aggreg: Categories and merchandise using Inherit follow this mode. Multiply applies each change to the previous result.
These rules apply to all categories and merchandise by default. Lower levels may disable inheritance. LDLib2 generates the list.
viscript_shop.data.category.inherit_prom: When disabled, this category and its merchandise no longer receive shop-wide rules. Category rules remain active.
viscript_shop.data.category.promotion_ag: Inherit follows the shop mode. Any other option overrides aggregation for all effective discounts in this category.
viscript_shop.data.category.promotion_ru: These rules apply to all merchandise in this category. Individual merchandise may disable inheritance. LDLib2 generates the list.
viscript_shop.data.merchant.inherit_prom: When disabled, only this merchandise item's own rules are used; shop-wide and category rules are ignored.
viscript_shop.data.merchant.promotion_ag: Inherit follows the category or shop mode. Any other option overrides aggregation for all effective discounts on this merchandise item.
viscript_shop.data.merchant.promotion_ru: These rules affect only this merchandise item. LDLib2 provides list add, remove, and drag reorder behavior.
viscript_shop.data.promotion.direction.t: A discount lowers currency and item costs and raises currency rewards. Output item quantities stay unchanged. A markup does the opposite.
A 20% Discount reduces targeted currency or item costs to 80% and increases currency rewards to 120%. Item costs are rounded down per trade, with a minimum of 1.
viscript_shop.data.promotion.gift_item.t: Each merchandise uses one gift item type with a configurable quantity. Merchandise rules override category rules, which override shop rules. The first valid gift rule at the selected level is used; gifts do not stack.
The rule applies when all conditions match. An empty LDLib2 list always matches.
viscript_shop.editor.promotion.inherited: This is a source summary. Edit rules on the shop or category page. The inheritance toggle controls whether they apply.
No parent promotion rules are currently available
viscript_shop.ui.promotion.gift_conditio: Requires the promotion conditions to be met
viscript_shop.data.promotion.condition.g: 24-hour time, e.g. 02:30 to 03:00. Includes the ending minute. A later start crosses midnight, e.g. 22:00 to 02:00. Use 00:00 to 23:59 for all day.
viscript_shop.data.promotion.condition.r: Checks the carried inventory, hotbar, offhand and armor, not ender chests or external storage. The stack count is required per purchase unit. Component filters can identify cards or coupons.
viscript_shop.data.promotion.condition.c: Off: keep the required items for repeat use (cards). On: consume per purchase unit when this promotion applies (coupons), once per rule even if multiple prices change. Failed transactions consume nothing. Gift rules consume only when a gift is awarded.
viscript_shop.message.promotion.items_un: Not enough promotion items, or the items changed. Reduce the purchase quantity or refresh the shop and try again.
